verdict.rationale: TeamViewer is a remote-access and IT-management SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server: a Web API exists, but that is a developer building block and earns no credit, and the Tia AI agent is an in-product assistant, not a server other agents can connect to. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec either.
